name: v2.2.0-M1
body:
## Highlights
- **Modern stateless server for MCP 2026-07-28**: #1170 by @chemicL

  The first step toward the stateless Streamable HTTP paradigm. It is a new server in `io.modelcontextprotocol.modern`, independent of the legacy `McpSchema`, and it passes all 37 required 2026-07-28 conformance scenarios.
  - **No sessions**: each request is handled on its own, which suits horizontally scaled deployments.
  - **One server, sync or async**: many concepts were simplified and allow the transport to choose whether to offload blocking code or not, freeing the user to use either a synchronous or asynchronous paradigm to implement features. 
  - **Your own catalogs**: tools, resources and prompts come from repositories you implement, so per-tenant, filtered and paginated catalogs are straightforward.
  - **Stream only when it pays**: handlers return plain JSON or SSE, user code decides.
  - **Not yet supported**: a modern client, tasks and SEP-2243 custom headers.

## Dependencies
- Upgrade Reactor to 2026.0.0-M2. #1191 by @chemicL

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/java-sdk/compare/v2.1.0...v2.2.0-M1

name: v2.1.0
body:
## Highlights

- Tool list filtering #1108 by @Kehrlann
- HTTP client transport rework: `HttpClient`-based transports are now `Publisher`-based, and request customizers compose on the builders.
  - #1079 by @Kehrlann and @chemicL
  - #1165 by @Kehrlann

## Enhancements

- extensions attribute on `ClientCapabilities` and `ServerCapabilities` (SEP-2133). #1064 by @YousefHaggy
- `ServerHttpHeaderValidator` replaces `ServerTransportSecurityValidator`. #982 by @neerajbhatt
- Streamable HTTP server session sweeping and keep-alive. #1130 by @Kehrlann
- Remove the 2024-11-05 protocol from Streamable HTTP. #1126 by @Kehrlann
- Reject non-application/json POST requests. #1164 by @Kehrlann

## Bug fixes

- Stream leak when resuming with LAST_EVENT_ID. #1127 by @Kehrlann
- STDIO `sendMessage` is now thread-safe. #935 by @nquinquenel
- Malformed request bodies return 400 INVALID_REQUEST with Jackson 3. #1168 by @Kehrlann
- listXyz() methods return re-subscribable `Mono`s. #1175 by @kamisheng
- NPE when changing features on a server with derived capabilities. #1178 by @itzjb
- NPE in `addRoot`/`removeRoot` when roots `listChanged` is unset. #1179 by @Kehrlann
- Automatic-Module-Name no longer contains hyphens. #1135 by @Kehrlann
- Log instead of aggregating exceptions in `JSONRPCErrorResponse`. #1182 by @Kehrlann

## New contributors

@slachiewicz, @YousefHaggy, @kamisheng, @itzjb, @neerajbhatt and @nquinquenel

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/java-sdk/compare/v2.0.1...v2.1.0

name: v2.0.1
body:
## What's Changed

* Upgrade conformance suite to 0.1.16, Spring AI conformance to 2.0.0 GA by @Kehrlann in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/java-sdk/pull/1032
* Return empty completion when no handler matches a valid ref by @jstar0 in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/java-sdk/pull/996
* Close response after sending error in McpStreamableServerSession#responseStream by @Kehrlann in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/java-sdk/pull/1041
* Fix error behavior on unregistered handlers in stateless server handler by @maff in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/java-sdk/pull/800
* Remove invalid WARN message for missing notification handler in stateless servers by @bperhaps in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/java-sdk/pull/835
* Fix SSE event classification to follow spec for missing event field by @iaJingda in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/java-sdk/pull/913
* fix: stop pagination on empty cursors by @nanookclaw in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/java-sdk/pull/954
* fix McpTransportContext.create() mutability issue and add tests by @iuliiasobolevska in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/java-sdk/pull/1076
* Bound HTTP server and client reads by @Kehrlann in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/java-sdk/pull/1102
* Bound STDIO server and client reads by @Kehrlann in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/java-sdk/pull/1103

## Depedency updates

* Bump json-schema-validator to 2.0.4 / 3.0.6, jackson to 2.21.1 / 3.1.4 by @joaodinissf in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/java-sdk/pull/1058
